description.en: A collection of security group rule objects.

description.zh:
描述信息。
长度为2~256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en: The description of the security group rule. It must be 2 to 256 characters long and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 目的端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。
description.en: The destination IPv4 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv4 addresses.

description.zh:
授权方向。
- egress：出方向。
- ingress：入方向。
description.en:
The traffic direction for the rule. Valid values:

- `egress`: Outgoing traffic.

- `ingress`: Incoming traffic.

description.zh:
协议类型。取值范围： 
         
- TCP：TCP协议。
- UDP：UDP协议。
- ICMP：ICMP协议。
- ICMPv6：IPv6的ICMP协议。
- ALL：支持所有协议。
description.en:
The protocol type. Valid values:

- `TCP`

- `UDP`

- `ICMP`

- `ICMPv6`

- `ALL`: All protocols.

description.zh:
目的端IPv6 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。 

> 该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置。
description.en:
The destination IPv6 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv6 addresses.

> This parameter and `DestCidrIp` are mutually exclusive.

description.zh:
源端IPv6 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。
> 该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置。
description.en:
The source IPv6 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv6 addresses.

> This parameter and `SourceCidrIp` are mutually exclusive.

description.zh:
访问权限。取值范围： 
         
- Accept：接受访问。
- Drop：拒绝访问。
description.en:
The access control policy. Valid values:

- `Accept`: Allows matching traffic.

- `Drop`: Denies matching traffic and drops the packets.

description.zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的目的端口范围。取值范围：
         
- TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200
- ICMP协议：-1/-1。
- ICMPv6：-1/-1。
- ALL：-1/-1。
description.en:
The destination port range for the rule.

- For TCP and UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end ports. For example, `1/200`.

- For ICMP, the value must be `-1/-1`.

- For ICMPv6, the value must be `-1/-1`.

- If you set `IpProtocol` to `ALL`, the value must be `-1/-1`.

description.zh: 安全组规则优先级，数字越小，代表优先级越高。取值范围：1~100。
description.en: The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。
description.en: The source IPv4 CIDR block. This parameter supports CIDR notation and single IPv4 addresses.

description.zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的源端口范围。取值范围：
         
- TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200
- ICMP协议：-1/-1。
- ICMPv6：-1/-1。
- ALL：-1/-1。
description.en:
The source port range for the rule.

- For TCP and UDP, the port range is 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start and end ports. For example, `1/200`.

- For ICMP, the value must be `-1/-1`.

- For ICMPv6, the value must be `-1/-1`.

- If you set `IpProtocol` to `ALL`, the value must be `-1/-1`.
The ID of the security group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens create-security-group-permissions --security-group-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --permissions Policy=Accept PortRange=80/80 Description=testDescription SourcePortRange=22/22 Priority=1 SourceCidrIp=0.0.0.0/0 IpProtocol=TCP DestCidrIp=10.XX.XX.14/32 Ipv6SourceCidrIp=::/0 Ipv6DestCidrIp=::/0 Direction=ingress --region cn-hangzhou
